{{Quote|The Imperial Frigate ''Red Wind'' has been identified near Plooriod IV.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]|<ref name="Tour of Duty" />}}
The '''Attack on the ''Red Wind''''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] near [[Plooriod IV]].

==Prelude==
The infamous [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''Red Wind'' had been located near [[Plooriod IV]] where it was experiencing a malfunction in its engines. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] and its [[Red Wind commander|commander]] had become notorious for committing a number of atrocities during their battles against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and several [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] crews urged an attack to seek out retribution.

==Attack==
Stranded above Plooriod IV, the frigate was protected by a [[Space mine/Legends|minefield]] and was awaiting repairs from [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] ''[[Onteba]]'' and ''[[Ramit]]''. The assault run was made in three waves of three CR90 corvettes, [[Arrow (corvette group)|''Arrow'']], [[Hammer (corvette group)|''Hammer'']] and [[Striker (corvette group)|''Striker'']], while two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] cleared the minefield and intercepted enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].

==Aftermath==
After the destruction of the ''Red Wind'', three [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruisers]] from [[Imperial Drydock IV]] joined the [[Outer Rim Imperial Fleet]] in preparation for an attack on the Rebels.

==Behind the scenes==
This event is portrayed in Operation 17 (Attack the Frigate ''Red Wind'') of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] expansion, [[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit|''Imperial Pursuit'']].
